title: Bundles
needsMain: Also needs the main Automatic purchases switch.
nowOpenGame: Open an RNGidle tab to see Glim’s current bundle.
nowSignIn: Sign in to RNGidle to compare it with your EP.
nowNone: Glim has no bundle in this shop.
verdictWould: Your settings would buy this bundle.
verdictClosed: Glim’s shop is closed right now.
verdictPrice: Too expensive for your price limit.
verdictContains: It has none of the items you asked for.
verdictPoor: You would not have enough EP left after your reserve.
verdictSold: No more are available for you in this shop.
whenHelp: How often and how many. The game allows up to 3 bundles per shop, depending on your shop level.
modeOnceHelp: Stops after the total below has been bought.
modeRestockHelp: Buys the amount below in every shop that has a bundle.
filtersHelp: Every filter you turn on has to pass. With none turned on, any bundle you can afford is bought.
maxPriceHelp: Skip bundles that cost more than this much EP each.
discountHelp: Skip bundles with less than this percent off their listed value.
reserveHelp: Never spend EP if it would leave you with less than this.
epInvalid: Enter an EP amount such as 2.5M, 1.5B or 3e9.
quantityInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000.
containsHelp: Only buy bundles that hold at least one of these items. Leave it empty to allow any bundle.
